meta.summary: AI spend envelopes set at 2.0x sector median for a scaling software company with normal controls across routing, agents, and shadow AI.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: AI tool purchases on personal or employee cards are not reimbursable if an approved equivalent exists on the company allowlist or a team subscription covers the same capability.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope burn exceeds 82% before month end or single-hour spend exceeds 2x rolling hourly average
Team envelope burn exceeds 100% or unattributed spend exceeds $500 in a rolling 24-hour window
Company envelope burn exceeds 110% or agent kill threshold breached and loop not terminated within 1 hour of alert

rationales.e1: Support team production inference at $211/day runs within the $5,000 monthly Support envelope and is correctly classified as COGS under the production environment rule; no action required.
rationales.e2: Data team nightly embeddings at $38 falls well within the $8,000 monthly Data envelope and carries a valid project tag; routine pass with no flags.
rationales.e3: Search team cost per request rose 96% overnight with flat volume, breaching the 35% variance band on the Engineering envelope; Engineering lead notified to review the deploy for model routing regression or prompt bloat.
rationales.e4: Marketing has three ChatGPT Team subscriptions this quarter, exceeding the team_subscription_threshold of 2; the third charge is rerouted to the approved OpenAI company account and the employee card transaction is blocked per shadow AI policy.
rationales.e5: The $4,800 fine-tune request from ML Platform exceeds the $4,000 fine_tune_over_usd threshold and requires Engineering lead approval before the job is submitted.
rationales.e6: The Growth team research agent reached 340 retries per hour against the 25-retry limit and $47/hr against the $40/hr kill threshold; the loop is terminated immediately, preventing an estimated $1,090 in uncontrolled burn.
rationales.e7: Growth team frontier-model exception for the demo build is within the 72-hour window and the incremental cost delta is below the $250 max_delta_usd cap; Engineering lead approval routes this to the frontier tier for the approved window.
rationales.e8: An unattributed personal API key at 22x baseline triggers ladder step 2 throttle; Engineering lead has 24 hours to assign a valid project tag or spend is blocked, preserving the experimentation carve-out for attributed work.
rationales.e9: The procurement agent's $499 dataset license purchase falls within the $600 single_txn_ceiling_usd and the data-licensing merchant scope on the agent card; transaction approved.
rationales.e10: The Design team AI video trial at $89/month duplicates a capability already covered by Sales' $1,400/year contract at 40% seat utilization; consolidating onto the existing contract recovers $840 in annualized unused seat value and the trial is rerouted.
rationales.e11: The $120 charge from an unrecognized inference provider in Engineering triggers the require_approval new_provider_rule; Engineering lead must complete the vendor security questionnaire before further charges are processed.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged to internal-tooling is classified as OpEx under the internal-tooling project_tag rule; the COGS classification is corrected and the tagging team is notified to apply the correct tag at submission.
rationales.e13: Month-to-date spend at 87% of the company envelope with 9 days remaining has crossed the 82% burn_alert_pct threshold; the alert issued at step 1 is active and team leads are pacing remaining spend against daily run rates.
rationales.e14: Weekly rollup complete; all team envelopes within approved bands, one open approval pending for e5, and shadow AI reroutes processed; no escalation required.
